description: This file defines the LruGrainDirectoryCache class, an internal sealed class implementing a cache for grain directory entries using an LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction policy. It includes methods for adding, removing, and looking up grain addresses with versioning, tailored for Orleans runtime's grain directory management.

classes.name: LruGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing a cache for grain directory entries with LRU eviction, used within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds or updates the cache entry for a given grain address and version.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainId)
methods.description: Removes the cache entry corresponding to the specified GrainId.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainAddress)
methods.description: Removes the cache entry matching the specified GrainAddress if it exists.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the GrainAddress and version for a given GrainId; returns true if found.
